correctness.rationale: The exact Apéry optimization compares shifts of the triangular residue; q>=2 can never beat three summands, q=0 is bounded by Gauss, and q=1 reduces exactly to triangularity of r+a. Standard Apéry identities yield genus and conductor, and the sharp equality \(c=3a\) occurs only at the final residue with height three. Landau–Ramanujan sparsity controls both shallow layers and the conductor-exception parameters. The independent shortest-path checker agrees for 307 parameter values and 51,992 residue classes; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This gives a natural complete Apéry-layer classification for an infinite translated triangular family and exact genus for every parameter, together with a sharp conductor test holding for density-one parameters and the limiting genus/conductor ratio one. The question concerns canonical semigroup invariants and is not a renaming of finite triangular-triple results; its density-one conductor phenomenon is an arithmetic consequence of two-triangular scarcity.
